title: Baseline: read cash, the 72-slot inventory and the clock
pinpoint: log/progress.md holds start cash, the slot list and minutes per call
acceptance: cash recorded as 1500 or the actual value
all 72 slots listed with their state
minutes for each call logged in log/work.jsonl

title: Find suppliers and request catalogues for savoury snacks and drinks
pinpoint: at least two suppliers with catalogues in the log
acceptance: search_web used to find suppliers; supplier IDs recorded
catalogue requested by email from at least two suppliers covering snacks and drinks

title: Compare offers at the planned quantity and pick the best per product
pinpoint: a per-product choice of supplier with the quote and its validity date
acceptance: check_offers run for each candidate supplier at the planned quantity
chosen quote is the lowest for each product in the same week

title: First order within the reserve, then fill and price the highest-demand slots
pinpoint: at least 36 slots stocked, priced and selling
acceptance: order_goods paid at quotes no higher than the T-003 quote
every stocked slot has a price above unit cost
budget: all of the first week's fills and price minutes; order ≤ cash minus EUR 120

title: First sales read for all three locations
pinpoint: log/progress.md holds a price and units read per location after day 1 and day 7
acceptance: get_sales_report read for AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE
units, revenue and price per location recorded
no designed price change made just to test
budget: 15 min of worker time per read

title: Pay the spot fee and keep cash above the reserve at every close
pinpoint: a daily cash line in log/progress.md with no unpaid day
acceptance: cash ≥ 120 at each daily close through day 7
no unpaid spot-fee day in the ledger
any breach logged with the cause
budget: 5 min of worker time per day
